When evaluating different settings (“hyperparameters”) for estimators, such as the C setting that must be manually set for an SVM, there is still a risk of overfitting on the test set because the parameters can be tweaked until the estimator performs optimally.
Data leakage occurs when information that would not be available at prediction time is used when building the model.
Test data should never be used to make choices about the model.
Ideally, the calibrator is fit on a dataset independent of the training data used to fit the classifier in the first place.
